title: Kross Limited (NSE: KROSS) — Institutional Underwriting Dossier & Stage 2 Playbook
holding_rationale: Zerodha holds a 1-share tracking position in Kross Limited (cost Rs 288.75, market value Rs 305.90, +Rs 17.15 gain, 0.01% weight). We retain it with a hard structural stop at Rs 212.00 (`holding_shares_to_sell = 0`). Price-blind underwriting rates the business CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL (PASS_WITH_WATCH). Trailer axles scaled to 43%–49% of revenue, and Q2 FY27 sales jumped +79.6% YoY to Rs 235.1 Cr. Yet 124-day working capital, 30.4% 3-year CFO/PAT conversion, -Rs 111 Cr cumulative FCF, and Oct 2026 dilution (6.75 Cr diluted shares) cap conviction at TIER_3. At Rs 305.90 (+16.19% above the 50-DMA), CMP asymmetry to our Rs 400.00 Base Target is 1.00:1. Wait for a pullback into Rs 268.00–Rs 282.00 with Q3 FY27 working capital < 105 days or Feb–Mar 2027 seamless tube trials on track. That lifts asymmetry to 1.69:1 against the Rs 212.00 stop.

holding_alerts.trigger: Daily close below Rs 212.00 (200-DMA / Oct 2026 preferential floor)
holding_alerts.instruction: Exit the 1-share Zerodha tracking position on a confirmed daily close below Rs 212.00 and pause new-capital entry.

holding_alerts.trigger: Pullback into Rs 268.00–Rs 282.00 support zone WITH Q3 FY27 working capital < 105 days or Feb–Mar 2027 seamless tube trials on track
holding_alerts.instruction: Scale beyond the 1-share stake only on a pullback to Rs 268.00–Rs 282.00 if working-capital or tube-mill gates confirm (1.69:1 asymmetry to Rs 400.00).

redeployment_plan.capital_source: Marginal Rs 1,00,000 IN equity capital under review (beyond the 1-share Zerodha tracking stake)

destinations.rationale: KROSS is extended +16.19% above its 50-DMA with 1.00:1 CMP asymmetry and 124-day working capital; retaining 100% cash preserves dry powder for a 1.69:1 entry at Rs 268–Rs 282.
destinations.entry_condition: Deploy into KROSS only on a pullback to Rs 268.00–Rs 282.00 WITH Q3 FY27 working capital < 105 days or Feb–Mar 2027 tube-mill trials on track.

destinations.rationale: APL Apollo Tubes (CMP Rs 2,251.60, ROE 25.32%, +4.55% above 10W EMA) offers cleaner Stage 2 timing and 1.65:1 asymmetry, but this marginal Rs 1,00,000 slice is held in cash pending broader shortlist allocation.
destinations.entry_condition: Consider on a separate shortlist allocation if APLAPOLLO holds above its Rs 2,153.67 10-week EMA support.

destinations.rationale: Jamna Auto (CMP Rs 148.93, ROCE 26.0%, P/E 25.46x) has superior capital efficiency and a 1.68% dividend yield, but is extended +10.84% above its 10W EMA with 1.35:1 asymmetry below our 1.50:1 hurdle.
destinations.entry_condition: Re-evaluate JAMNAAUTO only on a pullback into its Rs 132.34–Rs 137.42 support zone.

primer: Kross Limited makes safety-critical forged parts and single-piece extruded trailer axles in Jamshedpur, with axles at 43%–49% of revenue and Q2 FY27 sales up +79.6% YoY to Rs 235.1 Cr. Still, 124-day working capital, 30.4% 3-year CFO/PAT conversion, and -Rs 111 Cr cumulative FCF keep business quality at CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL. Zerodha holds a 1-share tracking stake (HOLD_WITH_HARD_STOP at Rs 212.00). At Rs 305.90 (+16.19% above its 50-DMA), CMP asymmetry is only 1.00:1. Our new-capital verdict is WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT (TIER_3) in the Rs 268.00–Rs 282.00 zone against a Rs 212.00 stop, offering 1.69:1 to the Rs 400.00 Base Target.
